definitions.gloss: medical record; patient chart; clinical record
definitions.explanation: The record a doctor is required to keep of a patient's examinations, diagnoses, and treatment. This is the legal and administrative term; in day-to-day hospital speech the same thing is called カルテ.

examples.japanese: {診療録|しんりょうろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor writes it in the medical record.

examples.japanese: {診療録|しんりょうろく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五年間|ごねんかん}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧づけられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Medical records are required by law to be kept for five years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{診療録|しんりょうろく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開示|かいじ}→開示：14562_kaiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Patients can request disclosure of their own medical records.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{診療録|しんりょうろく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{取|と}り→やり取り：07702_yaritori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧になった。
examples.english: The introduction of electronic medical records has made exchanging information between hospitals easier.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{診療|しんりょう}→診療：14183_shinryou⟧ (medical examination and treatment) plus {録|ろく} (record). The suffix {録|ろく} names formal written records generally: ⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧ (minutes), ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ (a record).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {診療録|しんりょうろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to create a medical record
- {診療録|しんりょうろく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開示|かいじ}→開示：14562_kaiji⟧: disclosure of medical records
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{診療録|しんりょうろく}: electronic medical record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カルテ→カルテ：11069_karute⟧: chart — from German Karte; the everyday word inside hospitals
- ⟦{病歴|びょうれき}→病歴：19429_byoureki⟧: medical history — the patient's past illnesses, not the document itself
